Nothing else changed.

The --phase gf2 sampling design was changed after its first execution returned ZERO admissible instances (a uniformly random GF(2)-subspace of dimension <= 12 in a 64-dimensional state space almost never contains a nonzero vector supported on a single word, so no Step-1 pair exists). Both designs are retained in the script, both are executed, and both readings are reported. No pre-registered prediction was altered.

It is INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL, produced no output, and is reported as a run rather than omitted. Run 5 repeated it with a lower internal cap and completed with capped=false.
